brief: Trial NCT02522598 (Vivozon, phase 2). What is its status and stated reason, and were results ever posted?

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 sponsored by Vivozon is a Phase 2 trial with an overall status of COMPLETED.
findings.notes: Confirmed via snapshot and live ClinicalTrials.gov record.

findings.claim: The trial has no stated why_stopped reason because the trial was completed rather than stopped.
findings.notes: why_stopped is null and why_stopped_category is blank.

findings.claim: Results were never posted on ClinicalTrials.gov for trial NCT02522598.
findings.notes: results_posted is false and results_first_post_date is null.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 started in August 2015, had a primary completion date of February 2016, and completion date of February 2016.
Enrollment for trial NCT02522598 was 38 participants.
The results due date for trial NCT02522598 was January 31, 2017, and it is past due.
No Drugs@FDA application was found for Vivozon or VVZ-149.

tool_calls.name: get_fda_approvals
tool_calls.result: 0 applications (No Drugs@FDA application found for this name. Cite fda:none:vivozon for that.)

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT02522598'
